n: Event <Dorothy's Vision - Retrospection> is now open

missions: Clear event stages 10 times, not including tutorial stages.
Clear event stages 25 times, not including tutorial stages.
Clear event stages 40 times, not including tutorial stages.

list:
A Rhine standard-issue file folder, designed for external presentations.
Technology is condensed into words, and laid out on paper.

A contact-free disinfectant sprayer equipped with facial recognition technology.
Passersby rarely slow their stride. Technology never stops, and neither do they.

Fully adjustable and seated with an ergonomic leather cushion.
Researchers often fall asleep on it, dreaming about next week's performance review and their unpaid loans.

A customized experiment table with test equipment and a computer connected to the Rhine terminal.
The flowers on it are picked from the barrens. Dorothy moved the plants inside, shielding them from the dangers of the outdoors.

A Rhine standard-issue file folder, designed for external presentations.
Ambition is justified as progress, categorized and filed.

The intuitive design allows the user to easily see the information they need, no matter where they are.
The front is progress, and the back is continuation. Technology is not restricted to one direction, and is always developing.
'These are all yours, but they aren't for you to use.'
theme: A Rhine laboratory recreated from descriptions by Operator Dorothy, among others. The pod nurtures dreams that nurture humanity, but things can occasionally backfire.

list: 'You Have to Wake Up in the End'

You have seen this journey at Trimounts through to the end.
The site is now a ruin due to out-of-control tech, but behind the curtain will forever be an undying force to prop it back up. You need to take care around technology, and be on guard against the powers behind it.
Clear DV-5 with a 3-star rating while defeating at least 1 R-31 Heavy Power Armor.

You have defeated a new model of never-before-seen weapon.
When something out of the ordinary is discovered, there's usually a complete system in place behind it.
During the 'Dorothy's Vision' event, obtain Operator Astgenne.

The first medal Astgenne received upon arriving at Rhodes Island.
If she's determined to break away from something, then she sure will. Life puts shackles on her that defy description, and she can only cut her fetters away and continue on.
During the 'Dorothy's Vision' event, spend a total of 2,400 Mysterious Reagents at the [Laboratory Recycling Depot].

You have experienced a day in the life of the typical Rhine Lab worker.
Running up data and getting results are hard enough as is, but your boss always saddles you with unimaginable inspection deadlines. You're lucky not to be crushed with debt, at least.
Complete all the content in [Data Collection] and collect the rewards.

You have flawlessly handled all aspects of your work experience.
Rhine personnel tell you that this is the simplest a day gets in their lives, workload included. You have decided to leave this place as soon as you can, to return to the office you know so well.
Complete all stages in [Test Site] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials, DV-S-1 and DV-S-2).

You have witnessed the shattering of a wonderful vision.
What broke this beautiful dream was not cruel reality, but the dreamer herself waking up and coming to. She doesn't wish to tie down those she loves—she wants to send them off to futures further flung.
Clear DV-EX-2 with a 3-star rating while activating at least 3 R-31a Heavy Power Armors.

You have made it to the pinnacle in your challenge against technology.
Tech ought to be a helping hand in humanity's advance, not a hindrance, but people always seem to love exploiting it for strife.
Clear DV-EX-7 with a 3-star rating without defeating Dorothy.

You do not consider Dorothy the true enemy by any means.
She founded a dreamland to fulfill her ideals, and destroyed that dreamland to prove her ideals.
Complete all stages in [Rhine HQ] on Challenge Mode.

You have seen the rainclouds drifting over Trimounts.
At the end of the wilds lies hope and opportunity, along with danger and misfortune.
Clear DV-8 with a 3-star rating, with 'Awaken' defeating no more than 2 friendly Operators with [Journey] while alive.

You have a staunch will, never perturbed by false visions, no matter how beautiful.
Some might choose to find blessings in falsehood. You have planted your feet in reality and testified to your standpoint.
set:
An engraved medal set that makes a full record of the incidents at the Trimounts Rhine Lab research base.
Science nurtures dreams and conspiracies, and the brilliance of humanity shines a stark light on the difference between the two.
One cannot always be a companion on the journey, in hopes of opening up the path to that point.
